answer: Proposal: conserve vouch slots. Each credential holds m lifetime vouches; minting a new one burns q slots from q distinct vouchers, m<q, checked by consensus counters, no issuer. A willow cutting roots in any wet ground; a sybil roots only where unspent slots exist, and a spent slot cannot wander to a second account. Net slots per mint are m−q<0, so credentials ever minted are capped: with m=1, q=2, never past 2N₀ however rich the attacker. Money buys slots, not more. Proven double-signs ripple a slash up the vouch chain, pricing vouches. Seams: dirty genesis N₀; sold slots.
